verdict.rationale: WooCommerce is an e-commerce platform, not an AI assistant or agent host, so consuming external MCP servers' tools (the MCP-client role) is outside its product category. The documented native MCP support (docs-14/29, probe-3) exposes WooCommerce *to* AI assistants as a server and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows WooCommerce acting as an MCP client.
